children: The national entry point to luxury housing edged down to $1,199,321 in September, Realtor.com says. That's 3.6% below a year ago and the 30th consecutive month of annual price declines. Every luxury tier is cheaper than a year ago, with the threshold for the top 5% of listings down 3.5% and the top 1% down 5.3%. Even so, luxury homes are selling faster than they were last September. Listings at the 90th percentile spent a median of 76 days on the market, three days fewer than a year ago. The luxury entry point is the lowest since January 2023, and 14.1% below its May 2023 peak of roughly $1.4 million. There are no clear signs yet of a reversal, Realtor.com says. (chris.wack@wsj.com)
